notes.title: Patch 0.1.12
notes.content:
- CHANGE: Previously, all enemies were fused starting at realm depth 40. This resulted in a sudden, sharp increase in difficulty. From now on, only one enemy will be fused starting at depth 40, two at depth 45, and so on until all enemies will be fused at depth 65.
- CHANGE: Hidden realm properties now have some restraints that prevent certain ones from being generated. For a few examples, the "No Resurrect" property cannot be found as a hidden property anymore, nor can the "Debuff: Scorn" property be found as a hidden property. This change was made to prevent players' party compositions from being completely nullified "by surprise".
- CHANGE: Enemies will no longer fade away when they die until all queued events are resolved. This should make it easier for you to understand what is happening in battle.
- CHANGE: Stat scrolls are now inherited from the primary parent during fusion.
- CHANGE: "Shadow Crash" spell has been changed: Enemies take damage equal to 10% of the caster's Intelligence for each time they've cast a spell in the current battle.
- CHANGE: Effects that cause dodging to be guaranteed to fail are now prioritized ahead of those that guarantee them to succeed. This change was made because there was no consistency between the two effects before and it felt very unpredictable.
- FIX: Creatures that die at the start of their turn should no longer be able to take a turn.
- FIX: Tons of bugs with the slot machine.
- FIX: Traits and other effects that are based on the total number of times a creature has cast a spell persisted outside of battles.
- FIX: Display issues with macros.
- FIX: When using the command to copy battle history to your clipboard, all text should now be copied correctly.
- FIX: Gambling Dwarf tickets didn't decrease if you only had 1 left.
- FIX: Several traits and perks that increase spell gem charges didn't work.
- FIX: Realm property that gives buffs to enemies no longer gives an infinite supply of the "Invisible" and "Rebirth" buffs - these will be applied at the start of battle and then never again.
- FIX: "Dark Anima" perk only worked at the end of the Animatus' turn, rather than at the end of each creature's turn as intended.
- FIX: "Pleasant Disease" trait didn't work.
- FIX: Debug message sometimes appeared while fighting the realm depth 63 boss.

- FIX: Several on-damage effects activated even if 0 damage was dealt to a creature.
- FIX: Rare crash related to the map in realms.
- FIX: Crash related to the realm depth 39 boss battle.
- FIX: There wasn't a legendary material for the Asura Bonebreaker's "Ferocity" trait.
- FIX: "Spirit Link" perk caused far more damage than intended.
- FIX: Animation speed for renegades was too slow.
- FIX: Floor decorations could be found even if you already owned them.
- FIX: After completing a realm quest, the race that enemies were fused with changed.
- FIX: When stat gains were prevented from the "Fear" debuff, the reason for this was incorrectly called "Taste of Fear" which refers to a trait.
- FIX: "Taste of Fear" trait didn't work correctly.
- FIX: When stat gains were prevented from the "Fear" debuff, the prevention text was sometimes displayed on the wrong creature.
- FIX: "Barrier" buff will no longer be applied or acknowledged if the amount of absorption is zero.
- FIX: Sometimes, decorative rugs were drawn on top of your creatures.
- FIX: Typo in "Debilitate" spell description.
- FIX: Thylacine Studios logo could sometimes be stretched too large when the game is restarted.
- FIX: Several display issues related to battle history and floating battle text that led players to believe that certain effects weren't activating correctly. The most common examples of this are with the "Charge" and "Whiplash" traits.
- FIX: Enemy creature sprites could sometimes appear in battle while holding down the F key even while they're dead.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.11
notes.content:
- FIX: Creatures could disappear from the Timeline.

- FIX: "Ditto" trait activated more often than intended.
- FIX: Crash related to "Hymn of Brawn" at the start of battle.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.10
notes.content:
- CHANGE: Re-coded the way the game handles the Timeline. This should resolve all bugs related to creatures losing their turns, being able to take actions while dead, and other inconsistencies. This change could also introduce new bugs so please let me know if you notice anything out of the ordinary in your battles.
- CHANGE: Players can no longer be afflicted with Frozen, Sleep, or Snared via realm properties. Note that Stone is already on this list as a result of a prior patch.
- CHANGE: "Always Dodge" realm property is now "Chance to Dodge". The numerical value of this property represents an independent chance to dodge attacks.
- CHANGE: "Chance for enemies to resurrect on death" realm property is now "Resurrect On Death". It has a 100% chance to activate for each creature, but can only happen once per creature. In addition, enemies now resurrect with 25% Health, down from 100%. This should make the property much less annoying.
- CHANGE: Updated the "Unsocket" description to make it clear that the material will be destroyed.
- CHANGE: "Meteor Shower" spell has been changed: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage three times. This spell was changed because the old one had an extremely vague description and its actual effect was difficult to understand.
- CHANGE: Re-worded the "Timewalk" spell description to make it easier to understand.
- CHANGE: Removed the option at Everett to cancel all projects, as this was implemented as a temporary measure as a result of a bug.
- FIX: "The Pot Lid" realm quest could be given to players even though it's obsolete.
- FIX: "Second Chance" trait didn't work.
- FIX: "Magic Barrier" trait worked on buffs as well as debuffs.
- FIX: Rare crash when summoning a creature.
- FIX: Rare hang when opening a treasure chest.
- FIX: "Desensitization" perk worked on buffs.
- FIX: Several bugs related to the "Endowment" perk.
- FIX: "Solace" trait was worded incorrectly.
- FIX: Crash related to the "Quantum Flux" trait.
- FIX: You could pan the map while viewing realm properties.
- FIX: You can no longer release a creature if you wouldn't have any creatures left afterward.
- FIX: Freeze related to "Unbidden Miracle" trait.
- FIX: "Ancestry" perk now gives the correct amount of traits. Note that your creatures can still receive duplicate traits. Also note that you need to have knowledge about a creature in order to have its trait added to the list this perk pulls from.
- FIX: "Adaptation" perk now gives the correct amount of buffs.
- FIX: "Hybridization" perk gave the wrong amount of health.
- FIX: "Independence" perk gave the wrong amount of health.
- FIX: "Purebred" perk gave the wrong amount of health.
- FIX: Crash related to "Staff" artifacts' spell gem slots.
- FIX: Decorations beeped when you interacted with them.
- FIX: Item Set manager now displays a page number.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.9
notes.content:
- CHANGE: "Stone" debuff can no longer be applied from effects that apply random debuffs.
- CHANGE: Realm Depth 42 boss is slightly easier.
- CHANGE: "Adrenaline Rush" spell no longer guarantees critical damage and each attack deals 15% normal damage. It has additional Charges to compensate.
- FIX: Display issue related to treasure chests spawning on top of some realm objects.
- FIX: Display issue related to god altars spawning near geysers.
- FIX: Movement collision issue related to moving the menagerie in your castle.
- FIX: Kingdom of Heretics decoration floor was swapped with that of Frostbite Caverns'.
- FIX: Display issue when a creature gained exactly enough experience points to level up after battle.
- FIX: Display issue related to taking damage from the "Cursed" debuff.
- FIX: Display issue with the experience gain screen that caused the experience bars to be less full than they should have been.
- FIX: Sometimes, creatures could lose their turns under certain circumstances.
- FIX: Hopefully, the above fix will also fix the issue with dead creatures being able to sometimes take a turn. Please let me know if you see this happen again.
- FIX: Gem upgrade sound would play even if you didn't have enough resources.
- FIX: "Ever Upwards" trait only resurrected one ally instead of all of them.
- FIX: The Riddle Dwarf could spawn earlier in the game than intended.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
- CHANGE: Realm properties are now introduced at realm depth 16, up from 10. The number of properties now increases more slowly until depth 86, when you'll have the maximum of 6 properties.
- CHANGE: Numerical values of realm properties now scale with Realm Instability. These values will be much lower than before at 0 Instability, and much higher than before at maximum Instability.
- CHANGE: Realm Instability now provides a larger increase to your item bonus.
- CHANGE: "Player Can't Gain Stats" realm property is now "Less Stats Gained".
- CHANGE: "Enemy Can't Lose Stats" realm property is now "Less Stats Reduced".
- CHANGE: "Immune to Attacks" realm property is now "Less Attack Damage".
- CHANGE: "Immune to Spells" realm property is now "Less Spell Potency".
- CHANGE: "Immune to Indirect Damage" realm property is now "Less Indirect Damage".
- CHANGE: "No Healing" realm property is now "Less Healing".
- CHANGE: Removed the "Enemies Copy Your Traits" realm property.
- CHANGE: Removed the "Immune to [Class]" realm property.
- CHANGE: Rebalanced item bonuses granted by all realm properties.
- CHANGE: Diamonds in the Frostbite Caverns are now animated.
- CHANGE: "Paramount" trait can now only activate once per turn.
- CHANGE: Optimized floating text in battles. If you found it slow before, please let me know if this made it any better for you.
- FIX: "Unwanted Knowledge" realm quest could sometimes not spawn enough bookshelves.
- FIX: "Righteous Concession" trait sometimes worked on buffs along with debuffs.
- FIX: Page number display was sometimes incorrect when enchanting gems.
- FIX: "Thrive On Death" perk gave stats based on the Animatus' stats rather than those of the creature that was killed.
- FIX: Display issue related to the "Damage Over Time" realm property.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
- FIX: Godspawn projects were available at the very start of the game. A temporary option has been added to Everett that allows you to cancel all your current projects in case you're stuck with one of these. This option will be removed in a future patch, so use it as soon as possible.
- FIX: Crash related to the "Big Boned" trait.
- FIX: Gods sold several items before they were supposed to.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
- ADD: "F Key" support for gamepads. It is bound to the top-most face button, which is Y on Xbox gamepads or Triangle on Playstation gamepads.
- CHANGE: Improved the appearance of enemy fusions. This was partially thanks to a bug fix.
- FIX: "Death and Decay" perk didn't always work.
- FIX: "Official Forums" link in the options menu linked to our old forums.
- FIX: Typo in the "Change its dialog" option for NPCs.
- FIX: Several summon-related effects didn't correctly apply minions.
- FIX: Attempted to fix an issue where Godspawn projects were available immediately from the start of the game. If you ran into this issue, please let me know if the problem persists.
- FIX: Typo in the "Resonance" spell description.
- FIX: You could interact with the same valve in the Caustic Reactor multiple times to complete its related Realm Quest.
- FIX: Crash related to the "Conflagration" spell.
- FIX: "Rampart" trait didn't work correctly.
- FIX: Several Animator perks only worked if your Animatus was in the first slot.
- FIX: You could enable Decoration Mode in rooms other than your castle.
- FIX: "Glory" perk benefited enemies rather than the player's creatures.
- FIX: "Big Boned" trait affected all creatures rather than only the creature who had the trait.
- FIX: Golden pot in Temple of Lies could be walked through.
- FIX: Several objects in various realms were drawn on top of your creatures.
- FIX: Crash in the main menu under certain conditions when scrolling through artifacts.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
- CHANGE: Made the Realm Depth 18 boss fight a little bit easier (reduced their health slightly and made their trait a little less potent).
- FIX: Freeze when interacting with certain battle-starting objects in realms.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
- CHANGE: In an effort to make the start of the game a bit more accessible for all specializations, the enemy count will increase at a slower rate than before, up to 6 creatures starting at depth 10. I'll probably make other adjustments to remedy this issue in the near future and tweak this change back toward its original amount, but this will hopefully be a good fix for now.
- FIX: Minions didn't stack correctly.
- FIX: Nortah is now always called Nortah.
- FIX: After you give a creature a good beating, it now correctly returns to Siralim rather than Nex.
- FIX: "Wasted Age" trait worked on all damage but it should have only worked on spells.
- FIX: Another crash related to fusion.
- FIX: Typo in "World Domination" trait description.
- FIX: You can no longer remove Everett from your castle. You can reset your castle layout via the decorations menu if you did this on accident and he'll re-appear.
- FIX: Removed some incorrect options from Everett while in Decoration Mode.
- FIX: Random bugs related to transformation spells.
- FIX: Another crash related to "Cast on Attack/Defend/Provoke/Heal" spell gem properties.
- FIX: Some players were able to fuse their Animatus which isn't supposed to be possible.
- FIX: "Chain Spells" trait now really does work correctly.
- FIX: Rocks in Path of the Damned only gave you 1 resource.
- FIX: You can now correctly allocate perk points to the "Extended Reach" perk.
- FIX: Buffs and debuffs could sometimes overwrite the Barrier buff.
- FIX: "Hand of Light" perk healed enemies instead of the player's creatures.
- FIX: Most summoning spells didn't work.
- FIX: "Mystify" perk had multiple bugs associated with it.
- FIX: Display issue related to equipping an artifact to a creature.
- FIX: "Dancing Blade" perk didn't activate at the end of each creature's turn - only the Animatus' turn.
- FIX: "World Domination" perk could cause the wrong creatures to benefit from Hemomancer traits.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
- CHANGE: Graves in the Frostbite Caverns now spawn Mummies instead of Wights. Related text and quests were adjusted to match this change as well.
- CHANGE: Reduced the variance and maximum value for the "Enemies Resurrect On Death" realm property.
- FIX: Crash when opening the bestiary at the very start of the game.
- FIX: Typo in the "Cabalist" spec description.
- FIX: Realm Quest "Polio's Burden" is now called "Nortah's Burden". And yes, I know his name is Nortah sometimes and Ludwin other times. I'll have to fix that in the patch after this one.
- FIX: Blood Grove spawned too many random objects.
- FIX: Djinn Dreamweaver's "Chain Spells" trait had some extra, undocumented effects it shouldn't have had.
- FIX: Crash related to the "Cast On Attack/Defend/Provoke/Heal" spell gem properties.
- FIX: Crash could occur when fusing creatures.
- FIX: Players could soft-lock their save files under certain circumstances. This fix should retroactively fix your save files if you ran into this issue. You'll need to interact with the god altar again and then you should be fine from there.
- FIX: Typo on the knowledge bonuses screen.
- FIX: "Companion" perk worked for enemies too.
